name: Lumbergh HUD
tagline: Supervise your Claude Code sessions from your glasses
description: Shows a swipeable deck of your live Lumbergh AI coding sessions — one card per session, state and next line at a glance — and lets you dictate a reply into whichever one you're looking at.
author: Jim Vogel

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Reads the session board and sends dictated replies to your Lumbergh server.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Captures your voice to dictate a reply into the selected session.
